# Province scope: 1..10 from the dwarven hold building, 0 without one.
aov_hold_level = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = dwarven_hold_01 }
		add = 1

	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = dwarven_hold_02 }
		add = 1

		add = 1

	if = {

		add = 1

		add = 1

		add = 1

		limit = { has_building_or_higher = dwarven_hold_08 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = dwarven_hold_09 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building_or_higher = dwarven_hold_10 }
		add = 1
	}
}

# Province scope: the level a dig aims for: the variable aov_dig_target_level, else the next level.
aov_dig_target_value = {
	value = aov_hold_level
	add = 1
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_dig_target_level }
		add = {
			value = var:aov_dig_target_level
			subtract = aov_hold_level
			subtract = 1
		}
	}
}

# Province scope: gold cost of a dig.
aov_dig_cost = {
	value = aov_dig_target_value
	multiply = 150
}

# Province scope: months a dig takes, 12 x (8 + 4 x (target - 1)).
aov_dig_months = {
	value = aov_dig_target_value
	subtract = 1
	multiply = 4
	add = 8
	multiply = 12
}
